{{Quote|We have our battleships. We have our droids. If Palpatine wants our wealth, let him come and take it.|Marath Vooro|<ref name="holo">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>}}
The '''Trade Federation resistance''' were a breakaway group of dissatisfied employees of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] led by [[Customs Vizier]] [[Marath Vooro]] that refused to acknowledge the conglomerate [[Imperial–Trade Federation treaty|new arrangement]] with the newly-formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that gave it control over the company in the immediate aftermath of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|As the Trade Federation signs this treaty of peace with the Empire, we recognize that our constituent parts are no longer under our control.|Sentepeth Findos|<ref name="holo">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>}}
The Trade Federation resistance held power in several parts of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], with a notable location being the [[Enarc system/Legends|Enarc system]], which was a former Trade Federation holding.<ref name="RHNSIE">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>

During the [[Five Veils Campaign]], the Empire crushed of the Trade Federation resistance, though a few of its members became part of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] nineteen years later.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
